**Easy Reader for Android, alpha.** Read PDFs aloud with the spoken sentence and word highlighted, mark and comment, in German and English. Documents and voices come from your computer (Easy Reader for desktop) over your own Wi-Fi or your own Nextcloud; nothing goes anywhere else.

### Installing

1. Download `Easy-Reader-….apk` below and open it on the phone. Android asks once to allow installing from this source (your browser or file manager).
2. If an Easy Reader that you built yourself is installed, **uninstall it first**: this app is signed with the release key, and Android does not update an app across different keys. Its local documents and notes go with it; what was synced to your computer or Nextcloud comes back after pairing again.

Later alpha versions update in place.

The desktop app is a separate release in the `pdfReaderWindows` repository.
